native_state_owner: MuJoCo qpos/qvel only; no door pose prescription or motor animation
coordinate_frame: X longitudinal, Y transverse, Z up; supplier component Z=0 adds declared body-bottom translation to reference world

source_geometry.replacement: Remove all ten previous CAD end-rib meshes and their volume moments before adding two new end-frame solids

mass_balance.payload_distribution: Recompute from 16 retained CAD-body solids plus two new end frames, with additive full spatial moments. The mass includes unitemized fixed equipment and is not a material density claim.
mass_balance.method: Compute new residual-door moments from new solid geometry; add native fan stator/rotor mass and full tensors with parallel-axis terms. Do not subtract a thick offset fan from a fictitious uniformly dense 0.6 kg thin plate.
mass_balance.validation: Every massive body must be SPD and satisfy principal inertia triangle inequalities; independently sum mass, first moment and full origin inertia after compilation.

mounting_parameters.hinge_axial_depth: Explicit adjustable research parameter relative to each end plane; default from frozen supplier
mounting_parameters.hinge_axis: Supplier candidate vertical unit axis; actual native hinge and all child mounts follow it
mounting_parameters.gaps: Supplier peripheral and center gaps are candidate dimensions; geometry identity must change if changed
mounting_parameters.native_bay_fan: Move existing bay_fan_stator and bay_fan_rotor under door_end_neg_y_neg; retain native joint names, axes, masses and motor ports. Update mount-site reference and sensor metadata.
mounting_parameters.latch: Implemented native site-to-site connect at the explicit free-edge and frame reference points. Preserved names and capture gates. Ideal spatial constraint, not physical lock hardware.

contact_boundary.default: New door/frame contact disabled unless a safe explicit configuration is chosen; no default squeeze or unverified friction load
contact_boundary.geometry: Implemented three inner-jamb/top strips per end and four leaf-perimeter strips per leaf; exact triangle clipping verifies every proxy lies in true solid material. No complete bottom-frame, door-interior or external-equipment contact coverage.
contact_boundary.audit: Evaluate actual native pair distances/contacts for closed and sampled opening states, and an intentional contact fixture. Account for native contact work once through the existing solver-constraint work column.
contact_boundary.switch: Optional explicit door_contact command with persisted state; changing settings must not bypass checkpoint identity or restore validation.

render_binding.resources: Deterministic composition from frozen body resource and supplier meshes; new real-byte geometry SHA in snapshot, binding and identity
render_binding.poses: Use actual native body reference and current poses, including fan and all leaf-mounted controls
render_binding.registry: Do not rewrite an old expected hash to accept unreviewed arrays or physical sensor mappings

verification: Frozen-source hashes and exact geometry replacement identities
Independent triangle volume, first and full second moments
Native mass budget and full tensor reconstruction
Single accepted step and atomic failure rollback
Real opening, closing, rejected premature latch and accepted captured latch
Door-carried fan mount forces and torque reference point
Full and half timesteps with energy remainder disclosure
Independent nonzero checkpoint restore and continuation
Compiled native and browser-bound mesh positions at actual solved poses
unverified: Actual hinge axial depth and latch mechanism

fan_coverage.other_three_status: Rigid door-attached visuals with residual mass allocation; no independent motor or rotor dynamics.
